name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low-light settings and keeps focus on the data, matching the competitive analysis findings. The trade-off is that some users in bright environments may prefer light mode upfront, but the toggle keeps the interface flexible without clutter. This balances visibility, enjoyment, and speed of use.

name: Pane
text: Dark mode hides errors when contrast drops—like Manus’s analysis warns. Light mode’s glare in dim rooms isn’t the real risk; the risk is users missing subtle errors in dark themes. A high-contrast toggle would settle it—test both against error visibility in varied lighting.
